name: Ketamine
tierNotes: Threshold: near-clean — the faintest softness only.

Light: still very close to clean; only acuity/desat/coolCast are perceptibly non-zero, and only just. The shared breathing/drift/flowWarp trio (the same surfaces-bow-along-their-own-contours mechanics most other substances use for baseline life) are on the 'late' curve, so they're barely present yet — enough that the render is never a dead static filter, not enough to read as distortion. No black surround at all — the frame is fully rectangular.

Common: breathing/drift/flowWarp are now clearly perceptible — walls and surfaces visibly bow/crawl along their own contours, gently — but stay well short of their ceiling (late curve keeps them at ~1/8 max here), which is the fix for feedback that Common had become 'too strong': it used to run these on the smooth curve (~half strength already at Common) stacked with a second, redundant bespoke drift mechanic doing the same job — removed the bespoke one and moved everything to late so Common reads as mild. Vertical doubling and painting-flattening begin in earnest partway through; world recession hasn't woken up yet. (Perf/lag fix: this profile briefly also carried the shared patternMask/symmetry params, which forced the shared P3 pattern pass to run its full expensive kaleidoscope/domain-warp computation on every frame from around Light onward — a substantial constant GPU cost for a texture effect ketamine's own kCubism/kDissolve already provide. Removed; P3 goes back to early-exiting for this substance. Stutter (frame-hold) was also on the smooth curve, freezing ~28% of frames even at Common, which read as literal lag — now on the late curve too, so it's rare until Strong/Heavy.)

Strong: only a small black margin so far — world recession and the k-hole surround now use a deliberately sudden two-part curve (feedback: the k-hole should feel like a discrete threshold, not a smooth ramp, and Strong shouldn't be 'covered by the black' but should still give a psychedelic vibe of its own) so the black stays modest here. What DOES carry Strong is genuine psychedelic-esque content: environmental cubism/scenery-slicing (PsychonautWiki's own documented ketamine geometry — 'algorithmic... synthetic... simplistic in complexity', milder and less intricate than a psychedelic fractal) across 11 facets with hard posterize banding, PLUS the dissolve pattern-crawl (previously Heavy-only) now pulled forward into Strong — flat, breathing, texture-masked pattern replacing much of the photo's colour without any black surround to speak of; breathing/drift/flowWarp are well past halfway to their ceiling too, so the whole frame is visibly alive.

Heavy: the k-hole arrives suddenly in the last stretch of the slider — recession and the surround darkening both spike hard between Strong and here (same total magnitude as before at full Heavy, just concentrated into a rapid final ramp instead of spread across the whole Strong->Heavy range), so moving the slider the last few percent should feel like falling through a trapdoor rather than a gradual fade. Cubism is at its ceiling across 11 facets with starker posterize contrast; the receded painting's structure crawls/breathes via a real 2D domain-warp, and its colour gives way hard to the same continuous, texture/luminance-masked pattern that started in Strong, now at full strength with a thin graphic band-edge contour line (an ink-like darkening, not a highlight) — flat, posterized, desaturated-cool, tinted from the photo's own dominant palette. Takes inspiration from the psychedelics' structure-driven pattern language while staying in ketamine's own documented 'algorithmic'/low-complexity register, never LSD/DMT's rainbow or fractal tiling.
